mapper.select: SELECT refund.id AS refund_id, refund.refund_no, refund.status, refund.amount, payment.payment_no, payment.channel, ticket_return.id AS return_id, ticket_return.return_no, ticket_return.order_item_id AS ticket_id, orders.id AS order_id, orders.order_no, refund.refunded_at, refund.created_at FROM refund_record refund JOIN ticket_return ON ticket_return.id = refund.return_id JOIN ticket_order orders ON orders.id = ticket_return.order_id JOIN payment_record payment ON payment.id = refund.payment_id WHERE refund.id = #{refundId} AND ticket_return.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
